mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the federal funds rate increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within the last month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the unemployment rate increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth by more than 1% over the last six months signals a weakening demand environment, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances when real GDP growth declines by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production by more than 2% within the last two months signals a strong supply-side response, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances when industrial production increases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances when CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 100,000 within the last month, it indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decrease > 0.3% and PAYEMS increase > 100,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% and a decrease in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% within the last month indicates a shift in consumer spending from goods to housing, which may lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer discretionary stocks underperform.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 5% and RSAFS decrease > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) being above 4% indicates a restrictive monetary policy, which leads to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4%.
